study.question: Under identical signed-product forward computation and capacity, does allowing auxiliary context-embedding gradients only through the multiplicative history branch outperform allowing both the additive residual and multiplicative branches, and what is the interaction between their two gradient paths?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g0-r0039-context_product reaches validation click AUC0.668457307890924 versus g0-r0039-context_product_blocked0.6678548720585206 (difference0.0006024358324034), but its switch detaches context simultaneously at the additive residual and rank16 product inputs. Therefore this comparison cannot identify which path provides useful auxiliary transfer or whether one suppresses the other. Earlier g0-r0031-adapter_context_only0.6670575100016033 used the additive adapter without the new product, so it is not a matched additive-only gradient control for the current architecture. Mechanism hypothesis: auxiliary context updates through the explicit signed multiplicative path provide task-conditioned history interaction, while auxiliary updates through the parallel additive residual may partly compete. Product-only auxiliary context transfer may preserve the useful route and exceed both-route transfer without adding representation capacity. This is an unconfirmed optimization hypothesis, not evidence of actual gradient conflict. Negative trajectories constrain the next test: replacing signed products with magnitudes gives transfer0.66732608069768 versus blocked0.6680771665782702 in g0-r0040; fixed signed power gives transfer0.6677487262108844 versus blocked0.6682691297926993 in g0-r0041. Round42 aligned length power0.6643574757465411 loses to reverse0.6682672260111558, constant-half0.6669871249023591 and signed bridge0.668457307890924. Hence the prior length-alignment prediction failed for that implementation; no beneficial length-adaptive mechanism is established. Earlier naive compressed-task0.6591942389399411 and anchored-task-query0.6604926719194907 did not beat the stronger source0.660646940486458; subsequent summaries or routing gains do not retroactively establish those failed mechanisms. Click performance is the selection objective. The incumbent mean four-task AUC0.7816164023142299 is below DIN0.8099233880793816, so it is not an all-task dominance result. The proposed ownership experiment must report each auxiliary task too.

predictions: Primary directional prediction: branch_product_only click AUC exceeds branch_both_bridge and branch_neither_bridge. Failure of either comparison rejects the proposed improvement for this implementation. branch_product_only exceeding branch_residual_only would support the predicted route ordering, provisionally at one seed.

Report factorial conditional contrasts: product effect at residual off = AUC(product_only)-AUC(neither); product effect at residual on = AUC(both)-AUC(residual_only); residual effect at product on = AUC(both)-AUC(product_only); residual effect at product off = AUC(residual_only)-AUC(neither). Interaction = AUC(both)-AUC(product_only)-AUC(residual_only)+AUC(neither). Negative interaction is predicted if the two training routes compete, but is not direct gradient-conflict measurement.
